In this video, I explore Shanghai, China’s financial capital and one of the most futuristic cities in the world!
From towering skyscrapers and the world’s fastest commercial high speed train to crowded streets, futuristic technology and the incredible Shanghai skyline, this city feels like a glimpse into the future.
But Shanghai isn’t just about modern development. Hidden between its massive skyscrapers are ancient streets, traditional markets and historic neighbourhoods that feel like stepping hundreds of years into the past.
